title: Brand Manager
description:
Your Company:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Brand Manager to join a growing and innovative organisation at a pivotal stage of its journey. Based in Norwich with a hybrid working arrangement, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of a customer-focused brand, helping to create meaningful experiences that resonate with customers whilst supporting ambitious growth plans.
Working closely with a range of departments across the business, you will play a key role in developing and delivering brand initiatives that strengthen customer engagement, drive commercial performance and ensure a consistent and compelling brand presence across all channels.

Your Role:
While in this position your duties may include but will not be limited to:
- Leading the development and delivery of the organisation's brand strategy and growth plans
- Ensuring a consistent, engaging and high-quality brand experience across all customer touchpoints
- Translating brand strategy into actionable plans, campaigns and initiatives that support wider business objectives
- Managing multi-channel marketing and brand activity to maximise customer engagement and brand awareness
- Overseeing content creation and messaging across digital, CRM, customer communications and marketing channels
- Supporting the ongoing evolution of brand positioning, identity and proposition to meet changing customer needs
- Using customer insight, market trends and performance data to inform decision-making and optimise brand performance
- Working collaboratively with sales, customer service, digital, e-commerce, CRM and development teams to deliver joined-up customer experiences
- Managing project timelines, budgets and priorities to ensure successful campaign delivery
- Line managing and developing junior team members, providing guidance, coaching and support
- Monitoring brand performance and making recommendations to improve customer perception, engagement and commercial outcomes
- Acting as a key point of contact for brand-related projects, challenges and opportunities across the business

What You Will Need To Apply:
- A minimum of 3-5 years' experience within a Brand Manager or similar brand-focused position
- Previous experience delivering successful multi-channel brand campaigns and initiatives
- Experience working within consumer, direct-to-consumer, subscription-based or service-led organisations
- Strong understanding of brand development, customer journeys and marketing best practice
- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multiple departments and stakeholders
- Excellent organisational and project management skills
- Strong commercial awareness with the ability to link brand activity to business performance
- Experience using customer insight, analytics and performance data to support decision-making
- Excellent communication skills with strong attention to detail and messaging consistency
- Degree qualification or equivalent experience within Marketing, Branding, Design, Digital Media or a related discipline
- A proactive, customer-focused and results-driven approach

It Would Be Beneficial If You Also Have:
- Experience within a regulated, healthcare, care, financial services or trust-based environment
- Previous involvement in brand repositioning, proposition development or business transformation projects
- Experience managing direct reports and supporting team development
- Exposure to customer advocacy, referral programmes, influencer marketing or partnership initiatives
- Knowledge of SEO, content strategy, performance marketing or experimentation frameworks
- Understanding of emerging digital trends, including AI-assisted search and customer discovery behaviours
- Additional training in brand strategy, customer experience, behavioural science or customer insight

What You Will Receive in Return:
This organisation is undergoing an exciting period of growth and transformation, creating a unique opportunity for a talented Brand Manager to make a lasting impact on the future direction of the business.
The successful candidate will receive a salary of up to £50,000, dependent upon previous experience and relevant knowledge. In addition, the company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and personal wellbeing.
You will have the opportunity to work alongside senior stakeholders, influence key business decisions and help shape a brand that customers genuinely trust and connect with.
As well as this, there are excellent opportunities for career progression, ongoing learning and personal development, allowing you to further enhance your expertise within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

To investigate this role further, please do not hesitate to contact:

Suzi Kocovska - Recruitment Partner

title: Business Development and Marketing Executive
description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for a proactive and enthusiastic Business Development & Marketing Executive to join a highly regarded professional services firm in Norwich. This is a full time maternity cover fixed term contract position with an immediate start possible.

Working closely with senior stakeholders, you will play a key role in supporting a wide range of business development, marketing, events and client engagement activities. This is a varied position offering exposure to both strategic and hands-on marketing initiatives within a collaborative and professional environment.

Key responsibilities:
- Supporting business development plans and initiatives across multiple teams
- Organising and attending events, seminars, webinars and networking activities
- Producing presentations, delegate packs and marketing materials
- Assisting with proposals, tenders, credentials and client pitches
- Maintaining CRM records and key contact information
- Coordinating legal directory submissions and PR opportunities
- Managing social media promotion and content distribution
- Assisting with internal and external communications
- Taking meeting notes and following up on agreed actions
- Supporting a variety of ad hoc business development and marketing projects

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience within a Business Development, Marketing or Events role
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience producing professional presentations and marketing materials
- The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
- A proactive and enthusiastic approach
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to attend events outside of normal working hours when required

In return, our client offers the opportunity to join a successful and supportive organisation with an excellent reputation, where you can further develop your career within a dynamic and growing team.

To find out more, please get in touch Emily at Pure for more information.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Location: Norwich
Contract: 18-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Salary: Competitive + Excellent Benefits

Are you a proactive and creative marketing professional looking for an exciting opportunity within a highly respected professional services environment? Reed Recruitment is delighted to be partnering with a leading law firm to recruit a Business Development & Marketing Executive to join their Norwich office on an 18-month fixed-term contract.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, supporting a wide range of business development and marketing activities that help drive growth, strengthen client relationships, and enhance the firm's reputation across the region.

The Role

As a Business Development & Marketing Executive, you will play a key role in supporting partners and fee earners with strategic business development initiatives. You'll be involved in the planning and delivery of events, marketing campaigns, client engagement activities, and promotional content.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting business development plans for teams, partners, and individual fee earners.
- Organising and attending client events, seminars, webinars, and networking opportunities.
- Representing the firm at external events, awards ceremonies, and industry functions.
- Producing professional presentations, delegate materials, and event collateral.
- Assisting with proposals, tenders, credentials, and pitch documentation.
- Coordinating business development meetings, actions, and follow-up activities.
- Managing submissions to legal and professional directories.
- Maintaining and updating CRM records and contact databases.
- Coordinating photography and PR opportunities.
- Promoting content across social media platforms.
- Supporting internal and external communications initiatives.
- Assisting with a variety of ad hoc marketing and business development projects.

About You

The successful candidate will be an organised, enthusiastic, and confident individual with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within a marketing, business development, or communications role.
- Strong event management and coordination experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience producing presentations, proposals, and marketing materials.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confidence working with senior stakeholders and managing multiple priorities.
- Knowledge of CRM systems and social media platforms.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint.
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel to events, including occasional evening commitments.

What's in It for You?
- Opportunity to join a highly regarded and award-winning professional services organisation.
- Exposure to a broad range of marketing and business development activities.
- Supportive, collaborative, and inclusive culture.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Hybrid working opportunities.
- Ongoing professional development and career-enhancing experience.

Interested?

Please call Michelle Topley on or email your CV to . Alternatively apply online.

title: Ppc
description:
We have an exciting role with our client based in Norwich who are looking to recruit a Biddable Manager to manage their large paid social media and PPC campaigns. This role is offering flexibility for home working.

The role responsibility will be to drive the maximum number of quality leads into the business.

Main Responsibilities
- Management of Paid Social channels for 3 national market leading brands with laser focus on ROI.
- Working with eight figure budgets on diverse range of biddable accounts, platforms (e.g. Meta, Google & Microsoft) and campaign types (e.g. Paid Social, Search, Pmax, Demand Gen).
- Developing & implementing audience (including first party data) and creative strategies which drive performance and growth for paid social channels.
- Optimising and briefing the wider team to create bespoke landing pages for paid social to maximise the volume of high-quality leads.
- Manage bids utilising an array of fully automated bidding solutions to offline conversion actions.
- Digital agency and supplier liaison from tech providers and key media owners including Google, Meta, Microsoft Ads.
- Collaborate with an award-winning London based Search agency to implement cutting edge PPC technology.
- Collaborate with tech platform Account and Industry managers to optimise campaigns and drive performance delivery.
- Martech usage including Google Marketing Platform (Campaign Manager, Search Ads 360, Display Video 360). Other martech including Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Bot Management tool.
- Report into Biddable Media Lead to ensure all activity falls in line with the wider paid media strategy.

Performance measures
- Primary Paid Media metrics such as cost per acquisition and return on investment/advertising spend.
- Secondary Paid Media metrics including of cost per click, click through rate, conversion rate.
- Spend to planned budget & cost of sale % by region by product.

Knowledge and Experience
- Digital marketing background (either client or agency side).
- Minimum of 2-4 years' experience of hands-on management of large paid social campaigns and budgets.
- Excellent analytical skills.
- Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written formats.
- Proficient user of Microsoft packages.
- Knowledge of Google Marketing Platform particularly CM & SA360.
- Experience in Lead Generation preferrable
- Knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads interfaces and Editors (although full training will be given).
- Specific Digital Marketing qualifications.
- Meta Blueprint certified

Please apply with your updated CV.
